description: Change an existing Kanban task: move it between columns (set status to doing when you start it, blocked when it waits on someone), rename it, or replace its notes or file anchors. Only the fields you pass change. Use amem_task_complete to finish a task and amem_task_add for new work. Returns the updated task as JSON; an unknown id returns an error.

anchors.description: Repo-relative files the task touches; replaces the old list.

body.description: New notes; replaces the old notes entirely.

id.description: Task id from amem_task_list or amem_task_add (task_…).

status.description: Kanban column. doing = being worked on now; blocked = waiting on someone or something.

workspace.description: Workspace or repo name. Omit to use the repository the agent is running in.

name: amem_task_update
